- Option B: Tue, Apr 26 — 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET
- Option C: Wed, Apr 27 — 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET

- Jamie Torres — Head of Platform (BlueForge)
- Priya Singh — Security (requested)
- Mina Haddad — Customer Success (Redwood)
- Dev Patel — Solutions Engineer (Redwood)
- Grace O'Connor — Program Lead (Redwood)
- Rishi Malhotra — Implementation Lead (Redwood, will join on the call)

Draft agenda (60m):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) High-level rollout plan & roles (15m)
3) Security & data flow (SSO, retention) — (15m)
4) Next steps & action owners (10m)

Attachments: stakeholder-map.xlsx (XLSX, 22KB), draft-kickoff-agenda.pdf (PDF, 18KB), calendar-propose.ics (ICS, 3KB).

If you can confirm a preferred slot and any additional stakeholders (security/compliance, infra, procurement), I will send a calendar invite with the final agenda and meeting link.
